title: Program search over kernel and base predicate
original_requirement: Run AlphaEvolve-style restricted program search over decomposition kernel and factor-base predicate, optimizing oracle cost under frozen replay/counting fitness.
acceptance_criteria: Restricted candidate language, compiler/cache/setup charges, immutable independent holdouts.
Kernel semantics certified; predicate size, yield and subgroup constraints matched.
Complete pipeline cost and failed candidate records; yield conservation remains in accounting.
remaining_gaps: Existing autolab infrastructure is a reusable evaluator, not a bound AlphaEvolve kernel/predicate search implementation.
Need candidate grammar, fitness process, replay equivalence, heldout corpus, cold/online costs and independent acceptance gate.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: Program search over the decomposition kernel and factor-base predicate. Frozen specs, replay certificates and a counted unit are exactly what an AlphaEvolve-style loop needs as a fitness function. The factor-base lab note mentions it and nothing ran. Aim it at oracle cost, not yield, since mean yield is conserved.
